Sam —

Appreciate the quick read. Short answers below and a recommended path. I pasted the contingency table from MAP-v2 (see attachment) for clarity.

1) Escrow agent — we will use an independent escrow agent (recommended list included in the map). Redwood will not self-hold funds.
2) Credit cap — option 2 (staged acceptance) sets a max credit at 15% of first-year committed ARR (not per-invoice), with staged release triggers tied to integration milestones.
3) SOC2 gating — proposed fallback: if SOC2 evidence delays acceptance, we move to the extended acceptance window (2025-08-15) with a temporary price hold for 14 days; the highest credit tier requires a >30 day slip from the original acceptance target. This prevents an immediate jump to maximum credit for short delays.

Recommended path (to meet Procurement's July 10 requirement):
- Confirm escrow agent (we can provide contract language by EOD Fri 7/4).
- Procurement issues PO for agreed base amount by 2025-07-10 (price hold confirmed).
- Acceptance window re-baselined to 2025-08-15 in MAP; credit/escrow mechanics as above.

Action items: 
- Sam: confirm preferred escrow agent from our shortlist and whether Legal needs specific JURIS language.
- Procurement: indicate preference between Option 1 (fixed holdback + release on acceptance) or Option 2 (staged acceptance + capped credit).
- Internal: Marissa, can you confirm whether Sales can approve a credit up to $75k? Jonas — if the preferred path exceeds that, will you authorize exec exception?

I'll attach a short redline to the commercial clause for Legal; see attached SOW-draft-redlines.pdf and MAP-v2.xlsx.
